comments.note: BUG (R2.5) in mcp-server/src/tools/workflow-handoff.ts — getQaHandoff(): Missing all-terminal early exit. When all WPs are COMPLETE/CANCELLED, getQaHandoff enters the allQaPassed branch and incorrectly returns READY_FOR_REVIEW. Expected: READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS. getDeveloperHandoff (§5.1) already has this check at the top: `if (wpDetails.every((wp) => isTerminalStatus(wp.status))) return buildHandoffResponse('Developer', 'READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS', ...)`. The same pattern must be added to getQaHandoff (§5.2). Failed test: 'WP-005: getQaHandoff — additional scenarios > R2.5: returns READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS when all WPs are COMPLETE'.

BUG (R3.4) in mcp-server/src/tools/workflow-handoff.ts — getReviewerHandoff(): Missing all-terminal early exit. When all WPs are COMPLETE/CANCELLED, getReviewerHandoff enters the allReviewPassed branch and incorrectly returns READY_FOR_DOCUMENTATION. Expected: READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS. Same fix needed as for getQaHandoff: add `if (wpDetails.length > 0 && wpDetails.every((wp) => isTerminalStatus(wp.status))) return buildHandoffResponse('Reviewer', 'READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS', ...)` at the top of the function. Failed test: 'WP-005: getReviewerHandoff — additional scenarios > R3.4: returns READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS when all WPs are COMPLETE'.
